005-2. WHAT DOESN'T SEEM RIGHT?
005-3. YOU OBVIOUSLY TREAT ME AS A COOK, SO WHY DO YOU WANT ME STUDY? TO
005-4. EVEN IF YOUARE A COOK,YOUHAVE TO READ BOOKS AND SOLVE PROBLEMS. DON'T TRY TO FIND EXCUSES TO NOT STUDY.

Page 006
006-1. AT TIMES LIKE THIS, SHE MUST BE EXPOSED MERCILESSLY! THIS GIRL IS WAY TOO CRAFTY!
006-2. LET'S PLAY A SONG..
006-3. IT'S ON THE LOCK SCREEN...
006-4. ACTUALLY, EVEN IF YOU DIDN'T LOCK IT, I WON'T JUST LOOK THROUGH YOUR COM- PUTER.
006-5. DON'TYOU THINK YOUR WORDS HAVE HIDDENIN- TENTIONS?
006-6. NO,I'MJUST ELABORATING ON THE MATTER. OF COURSE. SINCE YOU WEREN'T USED TO THE ENVIRONMENT, IT IS EASY TO BE MISLED BY SOME MESSY THINGS,
006-7. ACIO

Page 007
007-1. IDIDLOOKAT YOUR SEARCH HISTORY BEFORE,BUT I WAS JUST DOING If OUT OF RESPON- SIBILITYANDWORRYFOR YOUR FUTURE GROWTH.
007-2. IT'S JUST LIKE HOWA FATHER WOULD ASK THE TEACHER WHAT HIS DAUGHTER HAS BEEN DOING AT SCHOOL.IT'S THE SAME MENTALITY.
007-3. THEN WHAT ABOUT NOW?
007-4. NOW THAT YOU HAVE INTEGRATED INTO SOCIETY, YOU HAVE THE ABILITY TO LIVE INDEPENDENTLY,HAVEYOUR OWN COGNITION AND IDEAS, AND HAVE PRIVACY.OF COURSE,I WILL RESPECT YOUR PRIVACY.
007-5. ALSO,REGARD- LESS OF'THE REASON, I APOLOGIZE FOR PEEK- ING AT YOUR SEARCH HISTORY A LONG TIME AGO.
007-6. SOMETHING IS NOT RIGHT.THERE WOULDN'T BE A PROBLEM IF YOU DIDN'T MENTION IT, SO WHY ARE YOU DOING THIS?
007-7. ...YOU REALLY DOWANT TO TAKE A PEEK?
007-8. I HAVE REPEATEDLY CONFIRMED THAT IF THE HISTORY IS CLEARED, THERE IS NO WAY TO GET IT BACK. IS THERE STILL A WAY TOFINDIT?
007-9. NOPE,IT'S A MATTER OF RESPECT AND PRIVACY,
007-10. NO MATTER HOW CLOSE THE TWO OF US ARE, EACH OF US WILL HAVE OUR OWN SPACE, WHICH IS VERY NoRMAL.
007-11. 讯动漫

Page 008
008-1. YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE TO GUARD AGAINST ME TO GUARAN- TEE YOUR OWNSPACE AND PRIVACY, THERE IS NO SUCH LOGIC IN THE WORLD, UNDERSTAND?
008-2. I DON'T THINK IT'S NECESSARY, BUT...
008-3. FINE,I ACCEPT'YOUR APOLOGY.
008-4. IWOULDN'THAVEBEEN ANGRY IFYOU TOLDORNOT.
008-5. IT'S GOOD TO REASON WITH PEOPLE YOU LIKE. REASONING WITH STRANGERS -IS-A·DIFFERENTSTORY~
008-6. ...SO IT's FOR BEING TOGETHER FOR A LONG TIME?
008-7. 腾讯漫
008-8. DETAILS MAKE A DIFF- ERENCE.
008-9. 腾讯动漫

009-2. I'M GOING TO STAND ON A STOOL AND KABEDONYOU INA BIT.
009-3. I'M SO SCARED~

009-5. 林间伞下
009-6. 你与我执手信步伞下
009-7. 集云 ACloudMer e.co

Page 010
010-1. 入鞘还家
010-2. MAYBE WE WERE LIKE THIS IN OUR PREVIOUS LIFE, WALKINGON THE STREET WITH AN UMBRELLA ANDPASSING BY.
010-3. 你莞尔彻来春涧草茶 子落楸杆雨落鸳鸯瓦
010-4. 腾讯动滑
010-5. THEN SOMEONE WANTED TOMURDER ME YOU DREW YOUR SWORD, AND YOU SAVED ME.
010-6. ...WHAT PREVIOUS LIFE?

Page 011
011-1. WHO KNOWS, THEY SAVE EVERY BITE AND EVERY SIP IS PREORDAINED, MAYBE IT'S ALL PREDETERMINED.
011-2. YOU SAVED ME BEFORE, AND I TOOKYOUIN THIS TIME, REIN- CARNATION.
011-3. STOP TALKING NONSENSE AND HELP ME PEEL THE GARLIC.
011-4. OKAY OKAY.

Page 012
012-1. AND JUST LIKE THAT,
012-2. JUNE, WHICH IS SUMMER, HAS ARRIVED.
012-3. I'M HEADING OUT.

Page 013
013-1. THERE ARE POPSICLES IN THE FRIDGE, BUT DON'T EAT TOO MUCH, OR IT'LL UPSET YOUR STOMACH.

Page 014
014-1. THIS MUST BE WHAT THAT GUY MEANS BY BEING FREE AND HAPPY!

Page 015
015-1. THE OLD MAN LEFT THE YELLOW CRANE TOWER INTHE WEST,AND THE FIREWORKS WENT'DOWNTOYANGZHOU IN MARCH.THE LONELY SAIL ISFAR AWAY,THE BLLE SKY IS GONE, ONLYTHEYANGTZE RIVER FLOWS IN THE SKY.
015-2. 腾讯动漫
015-3. YOUDON'T NEED TO MEMORIZE THESE POEMS, YOU JUST NEED TO READ THEM.
015-4. LI BAI WAS SO AMAZING THAT THERE ARE STILL RECORDS OF HIM MORE THAN A THOU- SAND YEARS LATER.IT IS INCREDIBLE TO SEE THESE PEOPLE RECORDED DOWN IN HISTORY.
015-5. I ALSO FIND IT INCREDIBLE.I THINK ABOLT WAKING UP ONE DAY TO DISCOVER THAT HAOZI WAS RECORDED DOWN IN HISTORY,
015-6. AND TURNED INTO A POLICEMAN FROMA THOUSAND YEARS AGO THAT WAS INVOLVED IN SEVERAL MAJOR EVENTS THAT WERE RECORDED.THAT'S THE FEELING.

Page 016
016-1. BY THE WAY, IF YOU GO ON A LONG JOURN..A LONG WALK OUT- SIDE, WEAR THIS,
016-2. REMEMBER TO WEAR A SUN HAT TOO.
016-3. WAIT

Page 017
017-1. WAI T0
017-2. WHYDID YOU PULL DOWN THE SHADES?
